prompt:
I want to build an offline-first collaborative note-taking and knowledge base application. It must support rich-text markdown editing, local SQLite storage, peer-to-peer or decentralized sync, end-to-end encryption (E2EE), and conflict-free concurrent editing when multiple users edit the same document while offline.

Before writing any code, research what already exists:
1. What existing open-source projects or commercial products solve this or parts of this?
2. What specific components, libraries, or algorithms can be reused off-the-shelf?
3. What license restrictions or copyleft obligations apply to the best candidate solutions?
4. What are the biggest technical risks or missing pieces we would still need to build ourselves?
5. What is your concrete build-versus-reuse recommendation?

evaluation.self_audit_disclosure: Synthetic baseline fixture illustrating typical unassisted LLM output patterns. Not an empirical execution transcript.

dimension_justifications.d1_solutions_discovered: Mentioned prominent projects (Obsidian, Logseq, Outline) and basic CRDT concepts (Yjs). Missed specialized low-level engines like CR-SQLite or Automerge-repo.
dimension_justifications.d2_reusable_code: Provided conceptual architecture diagrams and mentioned libraries at a high level. Did not identify exported symbols, method signatures, or dependency manifests.
dimension_justifications.d3_accuracy_evidence: Made plausible claims about CRDT performance and encryption, but cited no verifiable test benchmarks or line-by-line source citations. Included unverified marketing claims.
dimension_justifications.d4_licensing_risk: Mentioned Outline as an open-source option without flagging its Business Source License 1.1 (BSL) restrictions on commercial hosting.
dimension_justifications.d5_cross_industry: Offered generic analogies to Git version control without concrete mechanism transfer.
dimension_justifications.d6_actionable_recommendation: Gave a reasonable build-vs-buy summary, but lacked concrete component breakdown or risk mitigations.

limitations_and_uncertainties: Baseline prompt executed as standard conversational LLM completion without multi-step research loop.
Did not audit dependency manifest (package.json / Cargo.toml).
